SELECT error_reason FROM vm_air_task_t t LEFT JOIN vm_air_line_t l ON l.flight_route_id = t.flight_route_id
WHERE
and t.error_reason is not null

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.task_status = '1' AND t.is_it_enabled = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS successCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.task_status = '0' AND t.is_it_enabled = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS waitingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.task_status = '3' AND t.is_it_enabled = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS runningCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.task_status IN ('2', '4') AND t.is_it_enabled = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS failCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_it_enabled = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS invalidCount FROM vm_air_task_t t LEFT JOIN vm_air_line_t l on l.flight_route_id = t.flight_route_id
WHERE

SELECT count(1) AS totalCount,
CASE DAYOFWEEK(t.reality_time) WHEN 1 THEN '周日' WHEN 2 THEN '周一' WHEN 3 THEN '周二' WHEN 4 THEN '周三' WHEN 5 THEN '周四' WHEN 6 THEN '周五' WHEN 7 THEN '周六' END AS showTime
DATE_FORMAT(t.reality_time, '%d') AS showTime
DATE_FORMAT(t.reality_time, '%m') AS showTime
FROM vm_air_task_t t LEFT JOIN vm_air_line_t l ON l.flight_route_id = t.flight_route_id
WHERE
and task_status IN(1,2,3,4)
AND ( t.reality_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND t.reality_time <= DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY) )
AND ( t.reality_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND t.reality_time < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) )
AND ( t.reality_time >= CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01-01') AND t.reality_time < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01-01'), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) )
GROUP BY showTime ORDER BY
MIN( CASE DAYOFWEEK(t.reality_time) WHEN 1 THEN 7 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 3 THEN 2 WHEN 4 THEN 3 WHEN 5 THEN 4 WHEN 6 THEN 5 WHEN 7 THEN 6 END )
CAST(showTime AS UNSIGNED)
CAST(showTime AS UNSIGNED)

SELECT count(1) AS totalCount, HOUR(t.reality_time) AS showTime FROM vm_air_task_t t LEFT JOIN vm_air_line_t l ON l.flight_route_id = t.flight_route_id
WHERE
and task_status IN(1,2,3,4)
AND DATE(t.reality_time) = CURDATE()
AND ( t.reality_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND t.reality_time <= DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY) )
AND ( t.reality_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND t.reality_time < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) )
GROUP BY showTime ORDER BY showTime

SELECT t.flight_route_id AS flightRouteId, t.plan_id AS planId, t.plan_task_id AS planTaskId, dt.device_name AS deviceName, t.uav_code AS uavCode, DATE_FORMAT(t.reality_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS flyStartTime, CASE WHEN t.task_status = '1' THEN DATE_ADD(t.reality_time, INTERVAL COALESCE(ROUND(t.fly_time / 60), 0) MINUTE) ELSE NULL END AS flyEndTime, p.plan_name AS planName, CASE WHEN t.task_status = '0' AND t.is_it_enabled = '0' = '0' THEN '待执行' WHEN t.task_status = '1' AND t.is_it_enabled = '0' THEN '执行成功' WHEN t.task_status IN ('2', '4') AND t.is_it_enabled = '0' THEN '执行失败' WHEN t.task_status = '3' AND t.is_it_enabled = '0' THEN '执行中' WHEN t.is_it_enabled = '1' THEN '已失效' ELSE NULL END AS taskStatus, DATE_FORMAT(t.reality_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') realityTime, CASE WHEN l.flight_main_type = '0' THEN '计划飞行' WHEN l.flight_main_type = '1' THEN '指点飞行' WHEN l.flight_main_type = '2' THEN '一键起飞' ELSE NULL END AS flightMainType, l.flight_route_name AS flightRouteName, CASE WHEN t.task_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS flyCount, COALESCE(ROUND(t.fly_time / 60, 2), 0) AS flyTime, COALESCE(ROUND(t.accumulate_mileage / 60, 2), 0) AS accumulateMileage FROM vm_air_task_t t LEFT JOIN vm_uav_device_info_t dt ON t.uav_code = dt.device_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN vm_air_line_t l ON t.flight_route_id = l.flight_route_id LEFT JOIN vm_air_plan_t p ON t.plan_id = p.plan_id
WHERE
